title: Valid Delimiter Enclosures
statement:
Given a string `s` containing only the characters '(', ')', '{', '}', '[' and ']', determine if the input string is structurally valid.

An enclosure is valid if:
1. Open brackets must be closed by the same type of closing brackets.
2. Open brackets must be closed in the correct chronological order.
3. Every closing bracket has a corresponding prior open bracket.
